segments.name: Marine Technology Business
segments.description: Underwater imaging sonar, diving and subsea hardware and software sold and rented to offshore, defense and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: Our Marine Technology Business revenues are derived from both sales and rental of underwater technologies.

segments.name: Acoustic Sensors and Materials Business
segments.description: Acoustic hydrophone, sensor and material supply plus ultrasound calibration services for medical, subsea, defense and research customers.
segments.evidence: PAL revenues are derived from sale of acoustic sensors and materials, in addition to the provision of calibration services.

segments.name: Defense Engineering Services Business
segments.description: Designs and manufactures embedded sub-assemblies and engineering services for prime defense contractors' integrated defense programs.
segments.evidence: Our Defense Engineering Services Businesses are suppliers of embedded solutions and sub-assemblies which they design, manufacture and sell as a component of mission critical integrated defense systems.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for sales and rentals of underwater technology, acoustic sensors and calibration, and defense engineering services.
